
 Usage: openajar workspace [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Workspaces: one per business or person, lanes from templates, and the login
 queue.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ list       Workspaces with their readiness (for example "18 of 29 ready")    │
│            and health.                                                       │
│ create     Create a workspace. Lanes from templates go into a workspace that │
│            exists.                                                           │
│ show       One workspace with its lanes, readiness, login URL and note.      │
│ update     Change a workspace. Changing its default proxy never moves        │
│            existing lanes.                                                   │
│ delete     Delete a workspace. Refused while it still has lanes, and while   │
│            it has memory unless                                              │
│            --with-memory.                                                    │
│ templates  Templates you can apply: the built-in ones and the valid files in │
│            $OPENAJAR_HOME/templates.                                         │
│ plan       Show what applying a template would do, without creating          │
│            anything. Exits 1 when there are conflicts.                       │
│ apply      Create a template's lanes in workspaces. Shows the plan first.    │
│            Safe to run again: it only creates                                │
│            what is missing, and a partial run says exactly what it made.     │
│ queue      Lanes the owner still has to log into or fix, with their login    │
│            URLs. Attention first.                                            │
│ ready      Mark a lane as logged in and ready.                               │
│ unready    Mark a lane as needing login, or with --attention as needing      │
│            attention.                                                        │
│ overrides  The proxy-rule overrides that were applied, newest first.         │
│ export     Write one workspace into one encrypted file: lanes (profiles and  │
│            fixed fingerprints), the workspace                                │
│            record and readiness, its vault entries, flows, schedules and     │
│            grant definitions. Running lanes are                              │
│            paused for the copy and started again. Nothing here is changed or │
│            deleted.                                                          │
│ import     Import a workspace export: verify every checksum, plan, then add  │
│            everything as one unit (rolled back if                            │
│            any step fails). Existing lanes are never replaced; lanes come in │
│            not running (they start on first                                  │
│            use).                                                             │
│ memory     Workspace memory: what agents and the owner wrote, with           │
│            provenance.                                                       │
│ members    People who sign in to the panel: invite, list, roles, remove.     │
│ profile    Profiles: a person or business, shown on all its accounts.        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
